name: Heat and Mass Transfer
description:
Modes of heat and mass transfer, molecular scale mechanisms in energy transfer and continuum approximation, fundamental conservation principles for analysis. 
Conduction and diffusion: Fourier’s Law of heat conduction; material properties; heat diffusion equation; 1-D steady state heat conduction; thermal resistance and resistance networks; insulation and critical thickness; 1-D steady state heat transfer heat generation, heat transfer from extended surfaces - design of heat sinks; 2-D steady state heat conduction; transient conduction, lumped capacitance method, transient heat conduction, spatial effects, semi-infinite solids; diffusion mass transfer – physical origins and rate equations, conservation of species, mass diffusion without and with homogeneous chemical reactions, transient diffusion.
Convective heat and mass transfer: Concepts of forced and free convection; convection boundary layers; laminar and turbulent flows; scaling analyses and non-dimensional parameters and their and physical significance; boundary layer analogies; effects of turbulence; heat and mass transfer coefficients; external and internal flows in laminar and turbulent regime; hydrodynamically and thermally developing flows; flow in non-circular channels; natural convection; boiling and condensation (phase-change) 
Heat exchangers: Types and applications; heat exchanger analysis using UA-LMTD and effectiveness-NTU methods. 
Radiation Heat Transfer: Basic concepts and properties; emission from real surfaces, diffuse surface, black and gray body approximation, radiation view factors; Kirchhoff's law of radiation, radiative heat transfer between diffuse gray surfaces in an enclosure.
